create_llmprompt_basic: create an LLMPrompt dataclass instance with default name and zero LLMs
create_llmprompt_prompts: create an LLMPrompt with a list of prompt strings for LLM evaluation
create_llmprompt_processors: create an LLMPrompt with response processors and message history flags
create_llmprompt_executor: create an LLMPrompt with a code executor for running generated code
build_llmprompt_config: build an LLMPrompt configuration with name, prompts, and keep_message_history settings
